exceptions.reason: GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5 is the Zod $ZodArray issue-accumulation DoS, patched in zod 4.6.6. Expo SDK 56 and @expo/cli still depend on zod ^3.25.76, whose main export is the Zod 3 API. Forcing zod 4 changes that export and breaks the CLI. The root CRM pins zod 4.6.7. Remove this when Expo depends on zod >= 4.6.6.

deepmerge 4.2.0 through 4.3.1 mergeObject prototype pollution. 4.3.1 is the newest 4.x release and is still affected. Expo SDK 56 pulls it through @expo/cli and expo, so the mobile audit gate reports the advisory on those high-severity parents. npm audit's only fix is Expo 51, which would leave SDK 56. Remove this when a patched deepmerge or Expo 56 release no longer installs 4.2.0-4.3.1.

GHSA-3g3m-2fjr-6pw4 is a high-severity advisory reported against @expo/cli 56.1.27, installed transitively by Expo SDK 56 (expo 56.0.24). npm audit's only remediation is expo@58.0.23, a major SDK upgrade (56 -> 58) that needs a full mobile regression pass, visual-locks review and a new TestFlight train, so it is out of scope for a CI-unblock change. Remove this when the mobile app moves to Expo SDK 58 or @expo/cli ships a patched 56.x.
